scenes.title: Two Baskets and a List
scenes.summary: After Tariq restores kitchen power, Nour and Salma grab woven baskets to shop at the Saturday neighbourhood market while Tariq rewires Room 9.

scenes.title: Sweet Lemons and Golden Honey
scenes.summary: At the bustling Saturday market, Salma teaches Nour how to choose fragrant lemons and honey when Ziad spots them and helps carry the heavy jars.

scenes.title: Twelve White Cups
scenes.summary: Rami meets the group at the market pottery stall and helps Nour and Salma choose thick white stoneware cups that keep tea hot.

scenes.title: Thursday Means Today?
scenes.summary: Back at the inn, Mazen proudly tells Tariq about the bargain café chairs he ordered—then realises he said 'Saturday' instead of 'Thursday'.

scenes.title: A Mountain of Chairs
scenes.summary: Nour and Salma return from the market to find Mazen trapped behind towers of unpainted folding chairs blocking the courtyard path.

scenes.title: Light in Room Nine
scenes.summary: Using the black tape from the market, Tariq finishes the new copper wiring and switches on the warm glass ceiling lamp in Room 9.

scenes.title: Inside the Piano Lid
scenes.summary: Under the new ceiling lamp, Suad, Nour, and Rami pull a folded sheet of handwritten piano music from behind the wooden music rest.

scenes.title: Ask My Aunt's Ledger
scenes.summary: Suad shows Mazen the unfinished handwritten waltz, and Mazen recognises his late aunt's handwriting—right as the city clerk leaves an urgent message.
